find: Take the glowing thing from the shelf to the customer.
got: Got it. Now give it to the customer.
wrong: Not that one. Take the one that glows.
basket: Two things this time: take both glowing things to the customer.
one: One down. Now the other one that glows.
more: Not yet. They wanted two things.

served.fine: Handed over. The customer nods and heads out.
served.perfect: Handed over in a flash. The bell rings them out.

late: The customer gives up waiting and leaves.
stopped: No more customers until you step out and back in.
learnFind: A customer! What they want glows on the shelf. Tap it to pick it up.
learnGive: Now tap the customer to give it to them.
